_about: Placeholder physics for the Hagelslag shelf's packages (hagelslag_shelf/placements.json): estimates, not measured.
A package's mass = density x the volume of its bounding box (placements.json's size_m), so a bigger package of a
kind weighs more. 'density' is in kg per litre of that box: the contents and the packaging, divided by the box.
'friction' is MuJoCo's sliding friction coefficient. MuJoCo takes the larger of the two touching surfaces' values,
so the gripper's own friction (the scene's 'friction' parameter, 0.8) decides grasps; these decide how packages
slide on the shelf and on each other.
'shape' is the collision shape: 'box' (placements.json's box; a bag's untilted box) or 'cylinder' (upright, its
diameter the smaller of the box's width and depth).
'products' overrides a kind's values for one product (its id in placements.json), e.g.
'fixtures': the friction of the shelf's parts (shelf.glb's fx_* nodes).
_clearance: each package's collision shape is this much smaller than its box (half on each side), so neighbours don't start touching
